newsitem.title: UK: Diplomat to take top post at aluminium institute.
newsitem.headline: Diplomat to take top post at aluminium institute.

text.p: A British diplomat will take over as secretary-general of the International Primary Aluminium Institute (IPAI) after Alan Payne retires from the post at the end of July, the institute said.

Robert Chase, who has spent most of his career in the British diplomatic service, will join the institute on July 1 and take up the position of secretary-general on August 1, the London-based IPAI said in a statement.
Payne has been secretary general of the organisation since 1989.
Chase, born in 1943, is a graduate and former scholar of Oxford University.
He has worked in the Far East, Latin America, Moscow and the United States, dealing at a senior level with economic and commercial matters.
He is currently the British director-general of trade and investment in Italy.
